name: Steady
description: +1 DEF and +5 HP growth. Weathers punishment.

name: Nimble
description: +1 SPD and +5 SPD growth. Hard to pin down.

name: Hardy
description: +2 HP and +10 HP growth. Slow to fall.

name: Keen
description: +1 SKL and +5 SKL growth. Rarely misses.

name: Brawny
description: +1 STR but -5 SPD growth. Hits hard, hefts slow.

name: Clever
description: +1 MAG and +5 MAG growth. A practiced mind for magic.

name: Lucky
description: +2 LCK and +5 LCK growth. Fortune favors them.

name: Cornered
description: +15 crit while below half HP. Fights hardest wounded.

name: Vigorous
description: +2 ATK while above three-quarters HP. Strong when fresh.

name: Lone Wolf
description: +10 avoid with no ally within 2 tiles. Fights alone.

name: Woodsman
description: +2 DEF while standing in forest. At home in the trees.

name: Studious
description: Masters a class 2 battles sooner. A quick learner.

name: Lazy
description: +1 STR and +1 DEF, but masters a class 2 battles later.

name: Reckless
description: When mastered, gains +2 ATK / -1 DEF instead of the class perk.

name: Quick Study
description: Earns 15% more XP. Grows faster than most.

name: Standard Bearer
description: +2 ATK and +2 DEF while adjacent to a living ally.

name: Overflowing Grace
description: Once per player phase, restoring HP to another unit with a healing staff also restores 3 HP to Sera.

name: Calculated Opening
description: +15 Hit when initiating against a full-health enemy.

name: Unbroken
description: +2 RES and +10 Hit at half HP or less.

name: Riding Guard
description: +2 DEF and +2 RES during combat initiated after spending at least 3 movement cost.

name: Open Skies
description: +10 Hit and +5 Crit when initiating without an adjacent living ally.

name: Dread Presence
description: +10 Hit when defending against an enemy attack.
